2897-3605-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy (with an additional activated ability) of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

401-2530-3944-5933.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-5933.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

4550-5567-8095-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-8095-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1021-4693-6303-6664.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-7730.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-7730.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4222-4474-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

579-1978-5793-6700.description:
Activate Sarevok's Tome by tapping it, adding four mana due to Mana Reflection triggers.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sarevok's Tome which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
579-1978-5793-6700.notes: If you have completed a dungeon, you can activate Sarevok's Tome's last ability any number of times to cast all nonland cards in your library.

4659-5086-5183-6705-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6705-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1274-2811-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2811-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2685-4321-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-4321-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

661-3685-3836-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Urza. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

206-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
206-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
206-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

176-560-2921.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

775-1409-5184.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

232-864-1235-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Eternal Witness tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3990-5143.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control can produce
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1978-2750-6479.description:
Cause Rainveil Rejuvenator to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat from step 2.

1698-3260-3540-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
1698-3260-3540-6747.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-6747.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-6747.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

341-1306-1690-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Umori.
341-1306-1690-2538.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
341-1306-1690-2538.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1525-5645-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

997-2781-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
997-2781-6132.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5330-5687-5691.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

359-372-1309.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-1309.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1329-1750-2793-4659-5261.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

3259-3263-4068-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-4068-5953.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-4068-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

132-186-4131.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

851-2933-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2011-2803-3263.notablePrerequisites: Mark of Sakiko attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2011-2803-3263.description:
Declare the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached and Najeela, if desired, as attackers.
If Najeela was declared an attacker, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko attached.
The creature triggers, adding at least {5}.
Repeat each combat phases.
If the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached has power six or greater, this combo will net infinite mana.

1479-3478-3678.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-3678.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
